newsitem.title: IRAN: Khatami wins Iran presidency with 20.1 mln votes.
newsitem.headline: Khatami wins Iran presidency with 20.1 mln votes.

text.p: Moderate former culture minister Mohammad Khatami was elected as Iran's president with 20,078,187 votes of a total 29,076,070 votes, the official Iranian news agency IRNA said on Saturday.

It said final figures showed that conservative Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, who has conceded defeat, received 7,242,859 votes, outsider Reza Zavarei received 771,460 votes and Mohammad Mohammadi Reyshahri received 742,598 votes. Some 33 million Iranians were eligible to vote in Friday's election to choose a successor to President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani. A total of 240,966 ballots were rejected as invalid, the agency said.
